title: Countersignature
description: A signed, portable receipt of a decision over an Intent. Countersign spec v0.1.

actor.description: Who decided, as channel:address — e.g. "telegram:8675309", or "default:timeout" when the Default fired.

policy.description: "approver" for an explicit human decision; "default" when the Intent's declared Default fired at the deadline.

public_key.description: base64url-encoded raw 32-byte ed25519 public key of the signing authority (43 chars, no padding).

signature.description: base64url ed25519 signature by public_key over the canonical receipt without this field (86 chars, no padding).
